title: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly sanitize and escape a popup shortcode attribute…
description: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin versions through 4.4.6 contains a vulnerability where a popup shortcode attribute is not properly sanitized and escaped. This flaw allows users with Contributor role or higher to inject arbitrary JavaScript code that executes in the context of higher-privileged users, such as administrators, when they view the affected content.
